card.name: Small adverbs after is/are before a noun
card.fires_on: Small qualifying adverbs such as just, really and not right after a form of "to be" (is, are, was) or an article. The adverb comes before a noun phrase like "the first step" or "a few".

modes.label: just after be-verb
modes.description: The word just follows is, are or was and leads into a limiting phrase such as the first step or a few.
